mapper.select: SELECT d.dept_name AS deptName, d.building, d.budget, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM instructor i WHERE i.dept_name = d.dept_name) AS instructorCount FROM department d ORDER BY d.budget DESC

SELECT i.dept_name AS deptName, COUNT(*) AS instructorCount, ROUND(AVG(i.salary), 2) AS avgSalary, MAX(i.salary) AS maxSalary, MIN(i.salary) AS minSalary FROM instructor i GROUP BY i.dept_name ORDER BY avgSalary DESC
SELECT COALESCE(t.grade, '未出分') AS grade, COUNT(*) AS count FROM takes t WHERE t.course_id = #{courseId} GROUP BY t.grade ORDER BY (t.grade IS NULL), COUNT(*) DESC, t.grade
